content.heading: A language for the work ahead.
content.body: A general-purpose programming language and toolchain built around one challenge: make useful software easier to write, understand, run, and deliver.
content.caption: Programming, re-examined
An editorial paraphrase of the project's own north-star question, not a quotation.

content.heading: Libraries and packages
content.body: Python has hundreds of thousands of packages and decades of libraries behind it. Guion ships 17 standard-library modules and a package manager that installs from a local path or a checksummed URL. It has no public package registry yet.
content.caption: Libraries and packages
content.note: The standard-library modules are listed in the language reference.

content.heading: Arrays and data science
content.body: NumPy and pandas make Python the default for numeric and data work. Guion does not have a native array type yet.
content.caption: Arrays and data science
content.note: Earlier tests that reached NumPy through Python are retired and no longer cited.

content.heading: A release you can use
content.body: Guion's first public build is a Linux pre-release, v0.1.0-preview, for Debian 12 on ARM64 and x86_64. There is no macOS package yet. Python is a released language with a long track record.
content.caption: A release you can use
content.note: Each archive on the release page has a matching SHA-256 checksum file.

content.heading: Learning it
content.body: Whether a new builder can learn Guion, find its APIs and make a realistic change from the guides is still being tested.
content.caption: Learning it
content.note: Learnability is listed as an open outcome on the project status page.

content.heading: Beyond the tasks measured
content.body: Every number on this page is for a named program on a named machine against a named Python version. The server results come from one run on each of two cloud machines; an Intel Xeon server measured Guion slower on an earlier build and has not been rerun. Free-threaded Python and PyPy were not compared.
content.caption: Beyond the tasks measured
content.note: Overall competitiveness remains open, in the project's own words.
